verdict.rationale: A built-in AI agent is a fair question for a terminal emulator, since some terminals ship one, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Alacritty has any AI agent, command planning, or approval-gated execution. The documented features cover vi mode, search, hints, multi-window, IPC via alacritty msg, and configuration, and the README stresses a minimal feature scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate terminal tasks to a built-in AI agent that plans and executes commands with my approval
